Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.Com/brqdigitalsolutions

title: Campaign Director
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Campaign Director em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Duration:1 year Employment type:Independent contractor agreement Location:Anywhere. Working hours must overlap at least 4 hours with GMT timezone Reporting to:Senior Director Salary:Approx. USD$50,000 depending on location Application closing date:June 1st 9am BSTHow to apply Do not apply through LinkedIn.Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here ( About the Secure Energy Project The Secure Energy Project (SEP) is a communications initiative that exists to build unstoppable support for a global shift to clean energy. We identify the obstacles slowing progress, then work with partners to design and run collaborative campaigns that remove them. We bring together allies across civil society, policy and industry to influence the narrative and politics of energy.The transition to clean energy can improve everything: lower bills, better jobs, cleaner air and more connected communities. Yet progress is still too slow and increasingly vulnerable to misinformation and political backlash.Now entering our third year, SEP is leading global communications efforts, coordinating campaign coalitions, and launching audience-led interventions in key countries. We're helping the climate movement fight smarter, faster, and together.Who we're looking for We're looking for a Campaign Director to help tell a bigger, bolder story about the energy transition - inspiring people to see clean energy as the foundation for healthier lives, stronger communities and greater security.You'll help shift how people think and talk about energy by building communications that reach beyond the usual audiences. You'll work with influencers, community voices, experts and unexpected allies to make clean energy feel practical, popular and urgent.To change everything, it takes everyone. That's why you'll help SEP play a leading role in networks that bring together hundreds of organisations working towards the same goal. You'll spot opportunities for collaboration, support the leadership of others and help turn shared ambition into joint projects that are more than the sum of their parts.Working closely with the Senior Director, you'll deliver news-driven, cutting-edge communications, support rapid-response work and coordinate with partners across our global network to share intelligence, test ideas and collaborate on high-impact interventions in public and political debates. This role is ideal for a strong communicator or campaigner who is both strategic and hands-on. You can translate big-picture strategy into compelling content, build trusted relationships with collaborators and move quickly when opportunities arise.We're looking for someone who is ahead of the curve on communications and campaigns. You understand that speeding up the shift to clean energy means breaking out of echo chambers, building alliances with new audiences and unlikely partners, and shaping news agendas in real time with digital-first, innovative tactics. You'll bring both the patience to take people with you and the punchiness to help shift the movement into a different gear.What you'll do Drive narrative change on energy transition Work closely with the Senior Director to deliver SEP's communications campaigns. Design innovative strategies, materials and interventions for major moments in the clean energy calendar, including summits, geopolitical events, campaign launches and report releases. Translate audience insights, polling and political analysis into strategic communications outputs tailored to specific audiences. Turn campaign strategy into creative ideas and interventions that can shift how people think and talk about energy. Help strengthen the wider clean energy movement by supporting the day-to-day coordination of SEP's global networks and coalitions. Plan and run meetings, workshops and follow-up processes that encourage lively communication, practical collaboration and shared delivery. Build clear workplans, outputs and timelines to support delivery across multiple fast-moving projects. Track progress and keep partners and donors up to speed on what's working, what's not, and what that means for our collective impact.Narrative monitoring and rapid response coordination Spot the moments that matter - tracking media, politics and digital conversations to identify where clean energy narratives can be advanced, defended or reframed. Coordinate partners across SEP's coalitions so the right voices are ready to speak out quickly, confidently and effectively. Produce rapid-response materials, including key messages, talking points, media pitches, briefing notes and digital content. Help SEP and its partners prepare for major events, risks and opportunities with clear plans, strong narratives and timely interventions.Media pitching and spokesperson training Support media outreach by drafting pitches, building targeted media lists, maintaining journalist relationships and proactively spotting opportunities to place clean energy stories and spokespeople. Identify strong spokespeople from across the clean energy NGO community and help prepare them for media interviews through messaging guidance, briefing materials and training opportunities. Build a broader, more diverse network of trusted voices for clean energy - including farmers, workers, community organisers, clean tech entrepreneurs, local leaders and others who can speak credibly to their own communities. Work with the Senior Director and other Communications Directors to activate spokespeople across traditional media and strategic online spaces.Strategic support and special projects Support the Senior Director with the design and delivery of new or evolving priority projects, ie. with our existing campaign to promote the benefits of solar power in Nigeria, or a cross-country campaign we're developing to turbocharge electrification in the lead-up to COP31. Assist in drafting materials for fundraising proposals and donor communications.About you: You have a hunger to change the world, and are willing to take risks to change it. You think innovatively about communications and campaigns - you enjoy experimenting with new and outside-the-box approaches. You can influence people - you understand what makes people tick and how to get them on-side. You think strategically and you can also get things done. You're extremely organised and you like keeping other people organised too. You're proactive - you don't wait around to be asked to do something, you take the initiative and crack on. You don't shy away from picking up the phone to strangers or chasing people who are ignoring your emails. You are confident enough to ask 'why?', to question the judgement of those more senior than you, and to admit when you've made mistakes. You have a good sense of humour, you don't take yourself too seriously and you have excellent people management skills. You are comfortable working in an organisation guided by feminist values and have zero tolerance for misogyny, racism and bullying.Essential skills and experience 5+ years of experience in a communications, campaigns or media role. Does not have to be within the NGO sector. A creative mindset and strong interest in using storytelling and digital campaigning to drive change. Experience supporting or delivering communications campaigns. Strong writing and editing skills, with a track record for producing impactful media and digital content. Experience pitching to the media, drafting press releases and media briefings, and identifying and supporting spokespeople to deliver messages effectively. Good understanding of energy and climate issues, or proven ability to quickly build subject knowledge. Experience working across teams, organisations, and geographies. Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment. Excellent English. Fluent Spanish would be a bonus, but it's not essential.What we offer A chance to produce communications work that accelerates the transition to clean and affordable energy and changes the world in the process. The opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a small, high-ambition feminist start-up with a growing reputation. A collaborative, flexible, values-driven team with space to test and learn. Flexible working conditions, because childcare or other caring responsibilities are not hobbies. Opportunities to work across borders with partners and change-makers in climate and energy. Competitive compensation. Approx. USD$50,000 depending on location and experience.How to apply Do not apply through LinkedIn.Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here ( Deadline June 1st 9am BST

title: Médico Gastroenterologista
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Médico Gastroenterologista em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

*OPORTUNIDADE PARA MÉDICO GASTROENTEROLOGISTA NA TELADOC HEALTH\ " Junte-se à Nossa Equipe de Saúde Digital!A Teladoc Health, líder global em saúde digital e inovação em cuidados de saúde, está buscando Médicos e Médicas Especialistas emGastroenterologia!Se você é um profissional comprometido com a excelência no atendimento ao paciente e deseja fazer parte de uma revolução na prestação de serviços de saúde, esta é a oportunidade que você estava esperando.*SOBRE A TELADOC HEALTH:* A Teladoc Health está na vanguarda da transformação da saúde, oferecendo acesso rápido, conveniente e confiável a serviços de saúde através de nossa plataforma digital. Nossa missão é tornar o cuidado de saúde acessível a todos, em qualquer lugar e a qualquer momento. Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.*O QUE PROCURAMOS:*Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade deGastroenterologia, de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos; PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADESFornecer atendimento médico especializado em gastroenterologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anamneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações do sistema gastrointestinal à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais, endoscópicos e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em gastroenterologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças gastrointestinais.Recomendar alterações no estilo de vida, dieta e hábitos alimentares para melhorar a saúde digestiva.Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde gastrointestinais.Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.Manter-se bem-informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.REQUISITOSFormação Acadêmica: Obrigatório: GRADUAÇÃO EM MEDICINA RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA (ou em andamento) OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM GASTROENTEROLOGIA (CLÍNICA OU CIRÚRGICA).Certificações: Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);  Certificado de Título de Especialista em Gastroenterologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho);  ou comprovante de matrícula em Residência médica. Pós ou Especialização na área;  Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil); Experiência: Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em gastroenterologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina e Atenção Primária à Saúde;  Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico na Atenção Primária à Saúde; Conhecimentos Específicos para a função: Prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios gastrointestinais.Competências Comportamentais: Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.Outros Requisitos Importantes: Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.Local de Trabalho: REMOTORemuneração e Agendamentos: a combinar durante processo seletivo.IMPORTANTE: MODELO DE CONTRATAÇÃO:Contratação em regime de Prestador de Serviços por contrato Pessoa Jurídica, necessário fazer parte como representante legal ou sócio de um CNPJ ativo, bem como possuir CRM do respectivo CNPJ ativo.Esta descrição de cargo/atuação tem caráter informativo e pode ser ajustada conforme a necessidade da empresa ou instituição que oferece a oportunidade de trabalho em telemedicina para Médico Clínico/Generalista Residente em Gastroenterologista.

title: Lead Website Designer
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Lead Website Designer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Lead Website DesignerLocation: Remote;  ability to work in US EST time zone required Type: Freelance About BX Studio BX Studio is one of the world's leading Enterprise Webflow agencies—and the 2025 Webflow Enterprise Partner of the Year. We specialize in launching custom websites, ongoing website optimization, and digital branding. We're a remote-first team of ambitious, creative collaborators focused on delivering exceptional digital experiences for the world's most forward-thinking brands. We've partnered with Reddit, Headspace, NBC, and Verifone, spoken at Webflow Conf four times, and have been a trusted Webflow Enterprise Partner since 2020. The Role We're looking for a Lead Designer to join our team on enterprise web projects for B2B and SaaS clients. This role is a fit for a Sr. Designer ready to step up, an Associate Design Director from a smaller shop looking to grow within a larger team, or a Lead Web Designer seeking to advance their career within a high-growth agency. You'll work closely with project managers, UX strategists, and developers throughout the full project lifecycle — from early strategy through final execution — while managing multiple projects at a time. This role is client-facing: you'll design systems, shape web content strategies, present work, lead design conversations, and collaborate across the team to deliver cohesive, high-quality web experiences. We're looking for someone proactive and self-sufficient, with a strong UX foundation and the experience to hit the ground running in a fast-paced agency environment. You'll also provide leadership to mid-level and junior designers, working with a Design Director to help shape creative vision while setting standards for quality, process, and visual storytelling. What You'll Do ● Own the creative process. Design end-to-end web experiences for enterprise clients — translating UX strategy into polished visual execution, from wireframes through final design, ensuring each web project delivers clarity, impact, and BX-level quality. ● Develop visual identity systems from scratch in short timeframes, adapting them into cohesive, scalable websites. ● Lead web content strategy—structuring information, messaging, and design patterns to maximize storytelling and usability. ● Design websites in Webflow-first workflows, collaborating closely with developers for seamless execution. ● Collaborate actively with PMs, UX strategists, and developers across every phase of the project. ● Present and communicate design decisions to clients with clarity and confidence. ● Balance multiple active projects simultaneously, managing your time efficiently across each. ● Contribute to a collaborative team culture — sharing feedback, flagging blockers early, and keeping work moving. ● Mentor and guide mid-level and junior designers, elevating their work and modeling best practices. ● Collaborate with cross-functional teams (graphics, UX, dev) to bring ambitious websites to life. ● Implement and refine processes within the design team to ensure smooth collaboration, efficient iteration, and consistent high quality. ● Stay ahead of trends in web design, storytelling, and Webflow workflows—bringing new ideas into BX Studio projects. What We're Looking For ● 4+ years of web design experience, ideally within an agency setting. Ideally, with B2B companies, SaaS brands, and digital-first identities. ● Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end web projects with clear UX and visual thinking, including strategy, visual identity, UX/UI, and final design execution. ● Strong UX foundation: wireframing, information architecture, and user flow thinking alongside visual craft. ● Comfortable working across a full project team — PMs, strategists, and developers — in a structured, waterfall workflow. ● Proven ability to lead client conversations, present creative directions, and navigate feedback professionally with clarity and confidence. ● Experience developing visual identity systems and scalable design systems applied across digital experiences. ● Solid foundation in content strategy, information architecture, and UX principles. ● High proficiency in Figma required.;  Webflow and Adobe Creative Suite a plus. ● Strong leadership potential—experience mentoring or leading designers highly preferred. ● Proactive and organized — capable of managing multiple projects and taking initiative without waiting to be directed. ● Process-oriented mindset: able to shape workflows and uphold creative standards in a fast-paced agency environment. Why Join BX Studio? ● Lead ambitious web projects for innovative B2B and SaaS brands. ● Step into a role that bridges Sr. Designer and Associate Design Director responsibilities. ● Grow your leadership skills while still working hands-on with design. ● Collaborate with a talented, supportive, and high-standard team in a flexible remote environment.

title: Network Operations Center Technician
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Network Operations Center Technician em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

SOC / NOC Technician (L1) — LATAM Acceleronix | Customer Support / Network Operations | LATAM  Location : Campinas, Brazil  Role Overview   We are expanding our Customer Support function into a 24/7 operation  and are looking for a SOC / NOC Technician (L1)  to support real-time monitoring, incident detection, ticket management, and escalation across our platform and connectivity environments . This role is the first operational layer for identifying issues, validating alerts, following playbooks, and escalating incidents to L2 or engineering teams with clear context. The focus is mainly on platform, APIs, connectivity, SIM/network behavior, and service availability . Device-level troubleshooting will be handled by L2.  Key Responsibilities   Monitor platform and connectivity environments in real time, including APIs, service availability, device telemetry, SIM status, and network behavior . Identify anomalies, validate alerts, and distinguish false positives from real incidents. Classify incidents by domain: platform, connectivity, or device-related . Follow predefined playbooks for common operational issues. Perform first-level diagnosis to identify whether the issue is related to API/backend, SIM/network/roaming, or device configuration. Create, update, and manage incident tickets in Fresh service or similar tools . Ensure proper ticket categorization, SLA tracking, and timely updates. Escalate incidents to L2, engineering, Customer Support, Solution Architects, or Connectivity/Carrier teams with structured information. Maintain accurate shift logs and support smooth handovers between LATAM, EMEA, and APAC teams. Highlight ongoing incidents, risks, and urgent operational priorities during shift transitions.   Required Qualifications   Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology , or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may also be considered. 1–3 years of experience  in technical support, NOC/SOC, network operations, or IT operations. Foundational understanding of mobile networks, SIM lifecycle, and connectivity concepts . Basic knowledge of APIs, monitoring tools, and log analysis . Exposure to cloud environments;  AWS basics preferred . Ability to follow structured troubleshooting steps and interpret system behavior. Comfortable working rotational shifts and on-call rotations . Native/fluent Portuguese and professional English required . Spanish is a strong plus for LATAM coordination.   Preferred Qualifications   Experience with telecom operators, MVNOs, IoT platforms, or connectivity providers. Previous NOC/SOC L1 or L2 experience. Experience with ticketing tools such as Fresh service, ServiceNow, or Jira Service Management . Certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Security+, JNCIA, AZ-900 , or similar are preferred but not mandatory.   Soft Skills   Detail-oriented, structured, and reliable. Calm under pressure. Strong ownership and accountability. Quick learner with strong pattern-recognition ability. Global mindset and collaborative approach. Technician mindset with interest in IT operations, systems, and network reliability.   About Acceleronix   Acceleronix is a global IoT solutions and services enablement provider, part of the Quectel ecosystem, dedicated to accelerating IoT projects for OEMs and enterprises worldwide. We deliver an integrated portfolio that includes an end-to-end IoT platform, edge-device management software, Connectivity-as-a-Service (eSIM, iSIM, vSIM), vertical software, mobile applications, and full-lifecycle cellular and satellite connectivity — empowering customers to build smarter, more efficient solutions while reducing complexity, eliminating risk, and speeding up time-to-market. With pan-regional R&D teams and expert support across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Acceleronix is expanding its footprint in Latin America to serve a rapidly growing base of IoT innovators across smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, connected mobility, and Industry 4.0.  Life at Acceleronix LATAM   At Acceleronix LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect. Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of a global IoT leader and the Quectel ecosystem Direct access to global R&D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the Americas Regular knowledge-sharing through internal Masterclasses, webinars, and cross-functional project teams A culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our development   Industries & Applications   Acceleronix's IoT solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in: Smart Metering & Utilities — Electricity, water, and gas metering solutions Asset Tracking & Logistics — Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility Smart Agriculture — Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking Smart Cities & Infrastructure — Street lighting, parking, public safety, environmental monitoring Industrial IoT & Automation — Predictive maintenance, factory automation, condition monitoring Connected Mobility & Automotive — Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility Smart Home & Consumer IoT — Connected appliances, energy management, security   Why Acceleronix LATAM?   Global Impact, Regional Focus —  Be at the forefront of IoT innovation across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America. Career Growth & Development —  Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization. Cutting-Edge Technology —  Work on next-generation IoT platforms, cellular connectivity, eSIM/iSIM, and edge-to-cloud solutions deployed in mission-critical applications. Diversity & Inclusion —  Join an inclusive, multicultural workplace where diverse perspectives are valued as key drivers of innovation and success. Global Team & Collaboration —  Collaborate with a global network of IoT experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem.   Compensation & Benefits   Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks Performance bonus/sales commission structure (role dependent) Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance) Health insurance with no co-pay Life insurance Paid time off International travel opportunities (HQ visits, global trade shows)   Explore Acceleronix — Links & Resources   We encourage all candidates to learn more about Acceleronix before applying. The links below will give you a full picture of who we are, what we build, and what it's like to work here. title: Network Operations Center Technician
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Network Operations Center Technician em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

SOC / NOC Technician (L1) — LATAM  Acceleronix | Customer Support / Network Operations | LATAM    Location   : Campinas, Brazil    Role Overview     We are expanding our  Customer Support function into a 24/7 operation   and are looking for a  SOC / NOC Technician (L1)  to support real-time monitoring, incident detection, ticket management, and escalation across our  platform and connectivity environments  .   This role is the first operational layer for identifying issues, validating alerts, following playbooks, and escalating incidents to L2 or engineering teams with clear context. The focus is mainly on  platform, APIs, connectivity, SIM/network behavior, and service availability  . Device-level troubleshooting will be handled by L2.    Key Responsibilities     Monitor platform and connectivity environments in real time, including  APIs, service availability, device telemetry, SIM status, and network behavior  .   Identify anomalies, validate alerts, and distinguish false positives from real incidents.   Classify incidents by domain:  platform, connectivity, or device-related  .   Follow predefined playbooks for common operational issues.   Perform first-level diagnosis to identify whether the issue is related to API/backend, SIM/network/roaming, or device configuration.   Create, update, and manage incident tickets in  Fresh service or similar tools  .   Ensure proper ticket categorization, SLA tracking, and timely updates.   Escalate incidents to L2, engineering, Customer Support, Solution Architects, or Connectivity/Carrier teams with structured information.   Maintain accurate shift logs and support smooth handovers between LATAM, EMEA, and APAC teams.   Highlight ongoing incidents, risks, and urgent operational priorities during shift transitions.     Required Qualifications     Bachelor’s degree in  Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology  , or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may also be considered.  1–3 years of experience   in technical support, NOC/SOC, network operations, or IT operations.   Foundational understanding of  mobile networks, SIM lifecycle, and connectivity concepts  .   Basic knowledge of  APIs, monitoring tools, and log analysis  .   Exposure to cloud environments;   AWS basics preferred  .   Ability to follow structured troubleshooting steps and interpret system behavior.   Comfortable working  rotational shifts and on-call rotations  .   Native/fluent Portuguese and professional English required  .   Spanish is a strong plus for LATAM coordination.     Preferred Qualifications     Experience with telecom operators, MVNOs, IoT platforms, or connectivity providers.   Previous NOC/SOC L1 or L2 experience.   Experience with ticketing tools such as  Fresh service, ServiceNow, or Jira Service Management  .   Certifications such as  CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Security+, JNCIA, AZ-900 , or similar are preferred but not mandatory.     Soft Skills     Detail-oriented, structured, and reliable.   Calm under pressure.   Strong ownership and accountability.   Quick learner with strong pattern-recognition ability.   Global mindset and collaborative approach.   Technician mindset with interest in IT operations, systems, and network reliability.     About Acceleronix     Acceleronix is a global IoT solutions and services enablement provider, part of the Quectel ecosystem, dedicated to accelerating IoT projects for OEMs and enterprises worldwide. We deliver an integrated portfolio that includes an end-to-end IoT platform, edge-device management software, Connectivity-as-a-Service (eSIM, iSIM, vSIM), vertical software, mobile applications, and full-lifecycle cellular and satellite connectivity — empowering customers to build smarter, more efficient solutions while reducing complexity, eliminating risk, and speeding up time-to-market.   With pan-regional R&D teams and expert support across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Acceleronix is expanding its footprint in Latin America to serve a rapidly growing base of IoT innovators across smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, connected mobility, and Industry 4.0.    Life at Acceleronix LATAM     At Acceleronix LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect.   Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of a global IoT leader and the Quectel ecosystem   Direct access to global R&D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the Americas   Regular knowledge-sharing through internal Masterclasses, webinars, and cross-functional project teams   A culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our development     Industries & Applications     Acceleronix's IoT solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in:   Smart Metering & Utilities — Electricity, water, and gas metering solutions   Asset Tracking & Logistics — Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility   Smart Agriculture — Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking   Smart Cities & Infrastructure — Street lighting, parking, public safety, environmental monitoring   Industrial IoT & Automation — Predictive maintenance, factory automation, condition monitoring   Connected Mobility & Automotive — Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility   Smart Home & Consumer IoT — Connected appliances, energy management, security     Why Acceleronix LATAM?    Global Impact, Regional Focus —   Be at the forefront of IoT innovation across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America.   Career Growth & Development —   Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization.   Cutting-Edge Technology —   Work on next-generation IoT platforms, cellular connectivity, eSIM/iSIM, and edge-to-cloud solutions deployed in mission-critical applications.   Diversity & Inclusion —   Join an inclusive, multicultural workplace where diverse perspectives are valued as key drivers of innovation and success.   Global Team & Collaboration —   Collaborate with a global network of IoT experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem. The links below will give you a full picture of who we are, what we build, and what it's like to work here. title: Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused
description:
Empresa está contratando Landing Page Designer, Conversion Focused em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Are you looking for an opportunity to make an incredible impact in the world of socially conscious brands?Lucyd Media is a social advertising agency, specializing in the compliant advertising for CBD, Cannabis, and other DTC wellness e-commerce brands. Our mission is to reduce human suffering and maximize human potential by facilitating the distribution of Conscious CompoundsTM We are currently seeking a strong landing page (LP) designer to lead the design and optimization of the post-click experience across our paid media funnels. At Lucyd, we believe the post-click experience is one of the biggest underutilized levers in wellness growth. We need someone who can bring real authority to that part of the funnel, move quickly, use AI aggressively, and help us create a more seamless conversion experience across the brands we serve. This role will use AI-assisted tools to rapidly generate and iterate on landing pages, while applying strong design judgment and conversion strategy. Ready to elevate your career? We're excited to hear from you. What You Will Be Responsible For: Designing and optimizing landing pages, offer pages, and funnel-specific product pages Translating ad hooks and offer strategy into conversion-focused page experiences Improving what users land on after the click, whether that is a custom landing page, PDP variant, or other post-click experience Supporting page testing, iteration, and optimization based on performance Identifying where the current post-click experience is creating friction or hurting conversion Helping define how landing pages should be requested, built, and improved within Lucyd Using AI tools to speed up production and increase design leverage Partnering closely with Growth Strategists, Advertising, and Post-Click teams  What We Are Looking For: 3+ years of experience in CRO-focused design, landing page design, funnel design, or conversion-oriented eCommerce design. A portfolio demonstrating at least 20 DTC/eCommerce landing pages or product pages (PDPs) you have designed. Candidates without relevant portfolio examples will not be considered. Experience designing for paid media funnels, not just general web design. You know how to align page structure and messaging to the promise made in the ad. Comfort using AI tools to generate and iterate on landing page designs quickly, while applying strong design judgment and strategic direction. You know how to use tools to move faster while still applying judgment and taste. Exceptional organizational skills, adept at juggling multiple projects while maintaining top-notch productivity and prioritization. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to manage client expectations and maintain strong relationships. Experience in DTC wellness supplements, cannabis or other restricted products or adjacent consumer categories is a plus  Success Roadmap: In 30 Days, You'll: Audit the current pages users land on after the click, including landing pages, PDPs, collections, and offer pages. Identify the highest-priority opportunities to improve conversion through better post-click experiences. Begin improving the process for how landing pages are requested, built, and reviewed. Design and launch your first new landing pages for active client accounts.  In 60 Days, You'll: Partner closely with Growth Strategists to align page structure with ad hooks, offers, and buyer intent. Start identifying patterns in what is driving or hurting conversion across pages. Own the design and optimization of post-click experiences for multiple active accounts. Contribute to a faster, more repeatable landing page production process  In 90 Days, You'll: Be the clear internal owner of conversion-focused post-click design Establish a more seamless system for building, iterating, and optimizing landing pages. Consistently use AI tools to increase speed, output, and design leverage. Provide strong guidance to the team on what users should land on after they click on an ad.  By Your One-Year Anniversary: You will have helped establish Lucyd's post-click experience as a meaningful performance lever across paid media. You will have contributed to: Faster landing page creation and iteration Higher-quality post-click experiences Better alignment between ads, offers, and page structure A more intentional system for designing and optimizing pages users land on after the click  Apply now to become an integral part of our mission to connect socially conscious brands with their audiences in meaningful ways.

description:

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:   The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries. The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad.  KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:   Quarterly package review   - Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope. - Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions. - Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process. - Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies. - Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region.  Group analyses   - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators.  One-off items   - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual. - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope. - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data.  OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:  The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable.  REQUIREMENTS:  Education:  Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant). Experience:  Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing. Languages:  Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable).  Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:   Technical Skills:  Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel);  experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable). Soft Skills:  Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement. Essential Qualities:  Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning.  In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

Empresa está contratando Senior C/.Net Full-Stack Lead Developer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

We are seeking a Senior C#/.NET Lead Developer to join our growing engineering team. This role combines hands-on senior development with day-to-day team leadership, working closely with the CTO. You will design and build software while also manage day-to-day engineering operations - including ticket creation and assignment, PR oversight, and team processes.This position is ideal for a senior engineer who is technically strong and has prior experience in a lead role - someone who enjoys writing production code, mentoring a talented senior team, and helping coordinate the day-to-day workflow so the CTO can focus on higher-level direction. You will work across application code and Azure infrastructure, partnering closely with the CTO to deliver scalable, reliable systems and keep a high-performing team running smoothly. Key Responsibilities Team Leadership & Engineering Operations  -  Work closely with the CTO to manage day-to-day engineering workload and ensure the team stays productive and unblocked  -  Own ticket creation, triage, and assignment, keeping the backlog healthy and priorities clear  -  Oversee pull request processes, ensuring code quality standards are upheld and reviews are timely  -  Maintain and improve engineering processes and standards across a predominantly senior team  -  Ensure strong database practices are followed across the team, including schema design, query efficiency, and data integrity  -  Serve as a technical point of contact for escalations, cross-team coordination, and architectural decisions Software Development & Feature Delivery  -  Design, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications and services using C# and .NET  -  Build application features that interact deeply with the database, balancing correctness, performance, and maintainability  -  Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services that integrate with internal and third-party systems  -  Participate in architectural discussions and influence technical direction across the stack  -  Perform code reviews and mentor team members on best practices in both application and database development  -  Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across application, database, and infrastructure layers Azure Cloud & DevOps  -  Design and operate solutions using Microsoft Azure, with a focus on reliability and observability  -  Support CI/CD pipelines and deployment practices using Azure DevOps  -  Work with monitoring, logging, and alerting to ensure system health and rapid issue resolution  -  Collaborate on infrastructure decisions that impact scalability, performance, and cost Required Qualifications Experience & Education  -  Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent experience  -  7+ years of professional experience in C#/.NET software development  -  Strong written and spoken English (C1 or C2 proficiency) Technical Skills (Priority Order)  -  Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, and .NET Framework  -  Proven experience in a lead or senior lead developer role, assisting engineering management with day-to-day team operations Strong SQL Server / Azure SQL knowledge from a developer perspective Experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs   -  Experience with Microsoft Azure services, including App Services, Storage, and Azure SQL Database  -  Experience integrating with third-party APIs  -  CRM system experience and familiarity with common CRM integration patterns  -  Front-end experience with Angular (7–17)  -  Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies  -  Proficiency with Git and Azure DevOps Soft Skills  -  Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical topics to non-technical stakeholders  -  Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities  -  Ability to work independently and take ownership of critical systems  -  High attention to detail and commitment to quality and reliability  -  Collaborative mindset with experience working in cross-functional, distributed teams Bonus Qualifications  -  Experience with communications platforms and APIs such as Twilio, Vonage, Plivo, or similar for SMS, voice, and messaging workflows  -  Familiarity with real-time communications protocols: VoIP, WebRTC, and SIP  -  Experience with open-source telephony platforms such as Asterisk or FreeSWITCH  -  Experience with message-based systems (Azure Service Bus, RabbitMQ, etc.)  -  Strong understanding of DevOps practices and production operations  -  Experience working in HIPAA-regulated environments What We Offer  -  Competitive salary commensurate with experience  -  Opportunity to own critical systems and influence architectural decisions  -  A collaborative engineering culture that values quality, accountability, and continuous improvement

title: Scrum Master (Pj)
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Scrum Master (Pj) em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Qual será o seu papel?O Scrum Master é o líder servidor responsável por estabelecer e sustentar o Scrum conforme definido no Guia do Scrum, além de integrar práticas de Kanban e Lean para otimizar o fluxo de entrega. Em um contexto de mineração, ele atua como o elo de eficiência entre as equipes de desenvolvimento e os desafios operacionais de campo, garantindo que o time supere impedimentos técnicos e culturais na integração de sistemas industriais.Responsabilidades Principais Facilitação e Coach Ágil:Conduzir ritos (Daily, Planning, Review e Retrospective) garantindo o foco em resultados e a melhoria contínua do Time de Desenvolvimento. Agendar, planejar, organizar e conduzir reuniões de planejamento, alinhamento e acompanhamento de projetos. Promover o engajamento de stakeholders e fornecer detalhes a todos os envolvidos nos projetos. Remoção de Impedimentos:Atuar proativamente para eliminar gargalos que afetam a produtividade, especialmente em integrações complexas entre sistemas de TI e ativos de TO (redes industriais, sensores e telemetria). Otimização do Fluxo (Lean/Kanban):Aplicar métricas de fluxo (Lead Time, Cycle Time e Throughput) para identificar desperdícios e aumentar a previsibilidade das entregas. Apoio ao Product Owner:Auxiliar o PO na organização do backlog e na compreensão da agilidade técnica necessária para produtos voltados à operação mineira. Gestão de Mudanças e Cultura:Promover a mentalidade ágil em ambientes tradicionalmente rígidos, facilitando a colaboração entre engenheiros de automação e desenvolvedores de software. Proteção do Time:Blindar a equipe de interferências externas durante a Sprint, garantindo o foco nos compromissos assumidos.Esperamos que você tenha: Formação Superior em Tecnologia. Vivência sólida como Scrum Master em projetos de tecnologia aplicada à indústria ou mineração (ex: Sistemas de Despacho, Automação de Ativos, Dashboards de Operação). Domínio profundo dos frameworks Scrum e Kanban. Conhecimento em princípios Lean Manufacturing/Lean IT (identificação de desperdícios e VSM). Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de ciclo de vida de aplicação (Azure DevOps ou Jira). Noções de integração TI/TO: Entendimento básico de protocolos industriais, sistemas MES e arquiteturas de nuvem para suporte à Indústria 4.0. Certificações (Essenciais): PSM I ou II (Professional Scrum Master) ou CSM (Certified Scrum Master). Certificações (Diferenciais): certificações Lean Six Sigma.Modelo de Contratação: PJ Modalidade de Trabalho: Híbrido

title: Especialista De Consolidação/Consolidation Specialist - Oportunidade Também Para Pcd♿
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Especialista De Consolidação/Consolidation Specialist - Oportunidade Também Para Pcd♿ em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION:      The Consolidation Specialist contributes to the production of Imerys' quarterly consolidated financial statements in accordance with IFRS standards, by overseeing the financial statements of the Americas subsidiaries with the Americas Consolidation Manager, and producing Group analyses in coordination with the Group Consolidation team (totalling 9 people), spread across Paris, Brussels, Singapore, and Campinas, covering overall a scope of approximately 220 entities spread across some fifty countries.   The Consolidation Specialist also collaborates closely with the administration team of the SAP FC consolidation software, as well as other departments within Finance (Reporting, Tax, Treasury), both in Brazil and abroad.    KEY TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:      Quarterly package review     - Supervise the correct and timely completion of quarterly reporting packages in SAP FC for the Americas scope.  - Analyze balance sheets and variances, equity analyses, tax reviews, and reconciliation of intercompany transactions.  - Ensure the resolution of blocking control and support reporting units with technical queries throughout the closing process.  - Ensure that the consolidated accounts of entities in the region comply with IFRS standards and Group policies.  - Establish, manage, and communicate reporting schedules and closing deadlines for the region.    Group analyses     - Contribute to global Group topics, including IFRS 16 (Leases) reviews, mining accounting issues, and other specific key performance indicators.    One-off items     - Assist units in preparing for quarterly closings by anticipating the IFRS treatment of specific transactions according to the Group accounting manual.  - Support Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A), divestitures, or internal mergers within the Americas scope.  - Define solutions to improve processes, reporting timelines, and the reliability of consolidated data.    OTHER IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS:     The position includes regular discussions with external auditors regarding the Americas scope and assistance with internal audit requirements. Previous experience in auditing is highly desirable.    REQUIREMENTS:     Education:   Bachelor’s degree in Accounting (Certified Accountant).   Experience:   Minimum of 5 to 7 years in accounting, with a strong focus on consolidation and external auditing.   Languages:   Fluent English (mandatory for writing and speaking) and advanced Spanish (desirable).    Know-how, skills, abilities and other characteristics:      Technical Skills:   Proficiency in Google and Microsoft applications (especially Excel);  experience with financial software and databases such as SAP BFC (reporting tool - desirable), SAP 4HANA (desirable) and Anaplan (desirable).   Soft Skills:   Team player, ability to build trust-based relationships with peers and international contacts, and focus on continuous improvement.   Essential Qualities:   Organized, strict adherence to deadlines, analytical mindset, autonomy, transparency, and a proactive attitude toward learning.    In commitment to Diversity, Equity and Inclusion, this opportunity is also aimed at candidates with disabilities.

title: Technical Assistant
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Technical Assistant em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Do you have experience in the technical field – preparing technical reports, testing equipment and providing a high level of customer service? Are you self-driven and goal-oriented, with a technical background and a passion for technology, innovation and sustainability? At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Technical Assistant based in Campinas. DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and want to be a global trendsetter in power efficient products and solutions. We aim to be the go-to partner for efficient power management, renowned for our intelligent platforms and smart solutions. About The Job The Technical Assistant will serve as a key member of the team, performing equipment testing and repairs, carrying out projects and applications of controls and instruments under technical parameters, and working under collaboration with our global colleagues. Working Tasks and Responsibilities Carrying out equipment testing and repair activities in accordance with DEIF’s technical processes, ensuring formal process requirements are met and keeping internal record systems up to date. Managing projects and applications of controls and instruments, developing technical specifications for equipment according to customer requirements. Providing technical support and service to internal and external customers, by telephone or in person. Carrying out commissioning, installation, start-up and field technical assistance. Preparing training materials and conducting training sessions for customers, either at DEIF facilities or at our customers’ sites. Specifying necessary components for repair, application or technical support of equipment for customer quotation. Providing technical support to the sales department as needed. Preparing technical documentation for the execution and sale of product applications and related projects. What You’ll Bring Technical training in electrical/ electronic fields. Higher education (University Degree) is an advantage. Experience in the technical field, preferably in power generation – electrical/electronic. Experience in preparing technical reports and handling client interactions. Ability to communicate in English – both writing and speaking. Self-motivated, with excellent communication skills. Well-organized, with a hand-on/proactive approach and a strong team player. Good understanding of the importance of health and safety in the workplace. Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application. At DEIF, we are Winning Together! We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential. We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category. Curious to learn more about the benefits of working at DEIF? Delve into the details by visiting our career page at.

title: Executive Assistant
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Executive Assistant em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

About the Role We are looking for a highly organized, proactive Executive Assistant to provide comprehensive administrative support to our executive team. This role is key in ensuring smooth coordination, communication, and operational efficiency across the organization. Key responsibilities Efficiently manage and prioritize executive calendars, schedules, appointments, and travel arrangements. Draft, edit, and prepare professional documents including emails, memos, reports, and presentations. Screen and prioritize incoming communication to ensure timely responses and proper direction. Coordinate and organize meetings, conferences, and events, including all logistics and materials preparation. Take clear and accurate meeting minutes, distribute them, and follow up on action items. Maintain confidential files, records, and databases with high accuracy and discretion. Build positive relationships with internal staff, clients, partners, and key stakeholders. Act as liaison between executives and internal/external parties to ensure effective communication. Support special projects, research, and analysis assigned by the executives. Identify opportunities for process improvement and implement efficient administrative systems. Qualifications and skills Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, or related field (preferred). Proven experience as an Executive Assistant or in a similar administrative role. Trilingual proficiency: Spanish, English, and Portuguese (required). Exceptional organizational, prioritization, and time-management skills. Excellent written and verbal communication abilities. Strong proficiency with productivity tools (Microsoft Office / Teams / Outlook). Research and project management skills. High level of professionalism, confidentiality, and discretion when handling sensitive information. Strong attention to detail and ability to deliver high-quality work within deadlines. Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to build relationships at all levels. Proactive mindset with strong problem‑solving abilities. Flexibility and adaptability to shifting priorities and work demands. Industry/sector knowledge is a plus. About Kerry Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.

title: Desenvolvedor(A) Servicenow
description:

Somos o UltraCSC+, um Centro de Soluções Compartilhadas criado para facilitar a gestão do dia a dia das empresas do Grupo Ultra, promovendo mais eficiência e produtividade em processos transacionais. Você soma com nosso crescimento! Aqui você é o protagonista da transformação que queremos. A sua paixão, senso de dono, responsabilidade e inconformismo são os combustíveis para chegarmos mais longe. Sobre a área Atuar como referência técnica e funcional da plataforma ServiceNow, sendo responsável pela sustentação avançada, evolução contínua e governança da solução, assegurando alta disponibilidade, qualidade dos serviços e aderência aos processos de Gestão de Serviços de TI (ITSM). O profissional atua de forma autônoma e consultiva, liderando tecnicamente demandas de média e alta complexidade, desenvolvimentos no ServiceNow App Engine / Low-Code, automações de workflows, integrações e iniciativas de automação e uso responsável de Inteligência Artificial, garantindo conformidade com políticas corporativas, requisitos de auditoria, segurança da informação e boas práticas de mercado (ITIL). No seu dia a dia você focará em: Sustentação e Operação ITSM Atuar de forma sênior na sustentação da plataforma ServiceNow, garantindo estabilidade, desempenho, disponibilidade e qualidade das entregas;  Atuar nos processos de Incidentes, Requisições, Problemas e Mudanças (GMUD), assegurando correta execução, priorização, categorização, registro e encerramento;  Atuar como ponto de escalonamento técnico para chamados de maior complexidade. Evolução da Plataforma e Desenvolvimento Desenvolver, evoluir e manter soluções utilizando ServiceNow App Engine / Low-Code;  Atuar com Flow Designer, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies e Catalog Items, garantindo aderência às boas práticas da plataforma;  Avaliar impactos técnicos e funcionais de mudanças, releases, upgrades e novas funcionalidades;  Conduzir e revisar testes técnicos e funcionais, garantindo qualidade antes de implantações em produção. Análise, Melhoria Contínua e Governança Conduzir análises de causa raiz (RCA), propondo e implementando soluções definitivas para incidentes recorrentes. Identificar oportunidades de melhoria contínua nos processos, dados e fluxos da plataforma;  Garantir aderência acontroles internos, auditorias, compliance e segurança da informação. Integrações, Automação e IA Atuar no desenho, desenvolvimento e sustentação de integrações entre ServiceNow e sistemas corporativos, utilizando IntegrationHub e APIs REST/SOAP;  Liderariniciativas de automação de processos e workflows, reduzindo atividades manuais e aumentando eficiência operacional;  Utilizar e orientar ouso de recursos de Inteligência Artificial e automação (ex.: Virtual Agent, assistentes, sugestões automáticas), garantindo rastreabilidade, conformidade, privacidade e segurança. Relacionamento, Comunicação e Liderança Técnica Atuar de forma consultiva junto às áreas de negócio, fornecedores e consultorias, entendendo necessidades e traduzindo em soluções técnicas;  Atuar como referência técnica para analistas juniores e plenos, apoiando no desenvolvimento técnico da equipe;  Garantir documentaçãotécnica e funcional completa e atualizada (processos, integrações, manuais e registros de mudanças). Para esta posição procuramos talentos que tenham: ServiceNow (Avançado): sustentação, administração e evolução da plataforma;  ITSM: domínio dos processos de Incidentes, Requisições, Problemas e Mudanças (GMUD);  ServiceNowApp Engine / Low-Code (Avançado): desenvolvimento e customizações;  Flow Designer, Business Rules, Client Scripts e UI Policies;  Integrações: experiência com IntegrationHub e APIs REST/SOAP;  ITIL: sólidos conhecimentos aplicados à operação e melhoria contínua;  Governançae Compliance: atuação em ambientes corporativos com auditorias e controles internos;  Automação e IA: experiência prática ou liderança técnica em iniciativas de automação e uso responsável de IA na plataforma;  Certificações: Trilha CSA (Certified ServiceNow Administrator);  Ensino superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas;  Visão sistêmica e pensamento analítico;  Autonomia, responsabilidade técnica e senso de dono;  Comunicação clara, postura consultiva e relacionamento interpessoal;  Capacidade deatuar como referência técnica e mentor;  Organização, foco em qualidade, governança e melhoria contínua. Oferecemos uma proposta de remuneração fixa e variável competitiva, além de uma série de benefícios, veja alguns deles: Plano de saúde Plano odontológico VA e VR valores competitivos com o mercado Auxílio Farmácia Licença familiar e Kit Ultra Família, 180 dias para licença maternidade e 20 dias para licença paternidade. Kit para mãe e bebê Auxílio Creche 24 meses de reembolso para mães e pais Auxílio ao filho com deficiência Gympass Previdência Privada Programa de Pós-graduação e Idiomas e parcerias educacionais Programas de saúde e bem-estar, quick-massage e ginastica laboral

SOC / NOC Technician (L1) — LATAM Acceleronix | Customer Support / Network Operations | LATAM Location : Campinas, Brazil Role Overview We are expanding our Customer Support function into a 24/7 operation and are looking for a SOC / NOC Technician (L1) to support real-time monitoring, incident detection, ticket management, and escalation across our platform and connectivity environments. This role is the first operational layer for identifying issues, validating alerts, following playbooks, and escalating incidents to L2 or engineering teams with clear context. The focus is mainly on platform, APIs, connectivity, SIM/network behavior, and service availability. Device-level troubleshooting will be handled by L2. Key Responsibilities Monitor platform and connectivity environments in real time, including APIs, service availability, device telemetry, SIM status, and network behavior. Identify anomalies, validate alerts, and distinguish false positives from real incidents. Classify incidents by domain: platform, connectivity, or device-related. Follow predefined playbooks for common operational issues. Perform first-level diagnosis to identify whether the issue is related to API/backend, SIM/network/roaming, or device configuration. Create, update, and manage incident tickets in Fresh service or similar tools. Ensure proper ticket categorization, SLA tracking, and timely updates. Escalate incidents to L2, engineering, Customer Support, Solution Architects, or Connectivity/Carrier teams with structured information. Maintain accurate shift logs and support smooth handovers between LATAM, EMEA, and APAC teams. Highlight ongoing incidents, risks, and urgent operational priorities during shift transitions. Required Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Telecommunications, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Equivalent practical experience may also be considered. 1–3 years of experience in technical support, NOC/SOC, network operations, or IT operations. Foundational understanding of mobile networks, SIM lifecycle, and connectivity concepts. Basic knowledge of APIs, monitoring tools, and log analysis. Exposure to cloud environments;  AWS basics preferred. Ability to follow structured troubleshooting steps and interpret system behavior. Comfortable working rotational shifts and on-call rotations. Native/fluent Portuguese and professional English required. Spanish is a strong plus for LATAM coordination. Preferred Qualifications Experience with telecom operators, MVNOs, IoT platforms, or connectivity providers. Previous NOC/SOC L1 or L2 experience. Experience with ticketing tools such as Fresh service, ServiceNow, or Jira Service Management. Certifications such as CCNA, CompTIA Network+, Security+, JNCIA, AZ-900, or similar are preferred but not mandatory. Soft Skills Detail-oriented, structured, and reliable. Calm under pressure. Strong ownership and accountability. Quick learner with strong pattern-recognition ability. Global mindset and collaborative approach. Technician mindset with interest in IT operations, systems, and network reliability. About Acceleronix Acceleronix is a global IoT solutions and services enablement provider, part of the Quectel ecosystem, dedicated to accelerating IoT projects for OEMs and enterprises worldwide. With pan-regional R&D teams and expert support across APAC, EMEA, North America, and LATAM, Acceleronix is expanding its footprint in Latin America to serve a rapidly growing base of IoT innovators across smart metering, asset tracking, smart agriculture, connected mobility, and Industry 4.0. Life at Acceleronix LATAM At Acceleronix LATAM, no two days are the same. You'll collaborate with a diverse, globally-connected team, engage directly with some of the most innovative OEMs and enterprises in Latin America, and contribute to technologies that are redefining how devices and people connect. Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment backed by the resources of a global IoT leader and the Quectel ecosystem Direct access to global R&D, product, and engineering teams across Asia, Europe, and the Americas Regular knowledge-sharing through internal Masterclasses, webinars, and cross-functional project teams A culture of continuous learning — we invest in your growth because your development is our development Industries & Applications Acceleronix's IoT solutions power innovation across a wide range of industries. As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to make a real impact in: Smart Metering & Utilities — Electricity, water, and gas metering solutions Asset Tracking & Logistics — Fleet management, cold chain, and supply chain visibility Smart Agriculture — Precision farming, greenhouse monitoring, and livestock tracking Smart Cities & Infrastructure — Street lighting, parking, public safety, environmental monitoring Industrial IoT & Automation — Predictive maintenance, factory automation, condition monitoring Connected Mobility & Automotive — Telematics, EV charging, micro-mobility Smart Home & Consumer IoT — Connected appliances, energy management, security Why Acceleronix LATAM? Global Impact, Regional Focus — Be at the forefront of IoT innovation across Latin America, backed by a global organization with teams in APAC, EMEA, and North America. Career Growth & Development — Access structured mentorship, international exposure, internal mobility, and clear advancement paths within a fast-growing global organization. Cutting-Edge Technology — Work on next-generation IoT platforms, cellular connectivity, eSIM/iSIM, and edge-to-cloud solutions deployed in mission-critical applications. Global Team & Collaboration — Collaborate with a global network of IoT experts across engineering, sales, marketing, and operations — and with the Quectel ecosystem. description:

Olá, futuro(a) PO (Product Owner PL/SR) ! ✨ Estamos em busca de um Product Owner versátil, capaz de atuar em duas frentes estratégicas: tirar novas ideias do papel (Zero to One) e liderar a transformação digital de processos existentes, convertendo operações manuais ou complexas em experiências digitais fluidas. Mais do que organizar tarefas, você será o responsável por estruturar a solução. Seja concebendo um produto inédito ou modernizando um fluxo operacional, sua missão é garantir que cada decisão técnica e de negócio tenha um propósito claro. Você atuará na intersecção entre estratégia, processos e tecnologia, impulsionando a entrega de valor real. Onde você vai jogar (Time e Estrutura): Você fará parte de uma estrutura robusta e colaborativa. Não atuará isolado(a), mas sim como peça central de uma célula multidisciplinar composta por: Time de UX/Design: Para garantir fluidez e usabilidade. Squad de Desenvolvimento & QA: Engenheiros focados em performance e qualidade. Especialistas de Negócio: Stakeholders com profundo conhecimento de mercado, com os quais você trocará experiências diariamente para desenhar a melhor solução. Seus Desafios e Responsabilidades: 1. Concepção e Estratégia (Foco em Resultado) Mentalidade de Construção: Liderar a descoberta de produtos, realizando benchmarking e pesquisas para identificar oportunidades reais, seja em novos mercados ou na otimização interna. Decisão Baseada em Fatos: Eliminar o "achismo". Utilizar dados e evidências para validar se estamos resolvendo o problema certo antes de iniciar o desenvolvimento. Entrega Incremental (MVP): Definir a primeira versão do produto com assertividade. O objetivo não é criar softwares complexos que demoram meses para sair do papel, mas entregar valor rápido e iterar com base no uso real. 2. Engenharia de Processos e Lógica Mapeamento de Cenários (As Is / To Be): Mergulhar na operação para entender o cenário atual e projetar o processo futuro otimizado. O software deve ser o reflexo de um processo inteligente. Raciocínio Lógico: Mapear fluxos condicionais e regras de decisão (ex: "Se Cliente A, então Ação B"), traduzindo a complexidade do negócio em diagramas visuais que tragam clareza absoluta para o time técnico. 3. Especificação Técnica e PRD (Product Requirements Document) Documentação Precisa: Criar PRDs que funcionem como a "fonte da verdade", contendo fluxogramas, regras de negócio e critérios de aceite detalhados para eliminar dúvidas durante o desenvolvimento. Wireframing e Prototipação Básica: Para demandas de menor complexidade ou validações rápidas de fluxo, você deve ter autonomia para desenhar wireframes ou mockups funcionais. Lógica de Dados: Estruturar logicamente quais dados, filtros e critérios são necessários para a construção de relatórios e telas, facilitando o trabalho da engenharia. Requisitos (O que buscamos em você) Histórico comprovado na construção e lançamento de produtos ou funcionalidades relevantes. Raciocínio Lógico Estruturado: Facilidade para quebrar problemas grandes em etapas menores, sequenciais e lógicas. Habilidade com Fluxogramas: Experiência em desenhar processos de forma visual (BPMN ou fluxos livres). Escrita Técnica de Excelência: Capacidade de detalhar requisitos cobrindo cenários de sucesso, erro e exceção com clareza impecável. Autonomia em Prototipação: Conforto em rabiscar interfaces funcionais para tangibilizar ideias. Comunicação Articulada: Habilidade de transitar entre o time técnico e os especialistas de negócio com fluidez, garantindo alinhamento total. Diferencial Competitivo IA como Copiloto: Buscamos profissionais que já incorporaram a Inteligência Artificial no seu fluxo de trabalho diário. Valorizamos quem sabe utilizar a IA como um parceiro intelectual e alavanca de produtividade — seja para estruturar cenários, refinar documentações, gerar insights de dados ou acelerar o dia a dia. PARA ISSO, OFERECEMOS PARA VOCÊ TRABALHAR CONOSCO: 01) Salário: A combinar (Enviar pretensão salarial) 02 Segunda a Sexta 03) Horário: 08h às 17h 04) Local de trabalho: Prédio Sky Galleria (no Shopping Galleria), na Cidade de Campinas/SP 05) Regime de trabalho: HÍBRIDO (seguindo os critérios da política interna) 06) Regime de contratação: CLT 07) Plano de carreira 08) Cesta básica R$250,00 09) Vale refeição no total de R$ 32,00/ dia 10) Vale transporte c/ desconto 6%, pago em dinheiro ou Auxilio combustível fixo de R$ 300,00 11) Benefícios de VR, Cesta e Auxilio combustível, pagos através de um cartão unificado e flexível, operadora pela Sólides, para utilização na modalidade de crédito, bandeira Mastercard e que é aceito em uma infinidade de estabelecimentos 12) Convênio Farmácia,que conta com ofertas exclusivas e crédito de R$ 300,00 com desconto em folha de pagamento 13) Confraternizações: última quarta-feira (COFFEE BREAK) do mês 14) Parceria com Instituição de Ensino Anhanguera/Grupo Cogna 15) Descontos em lojas e restaurantes do Galleria Shopping 16) Estacionamento do shopping com valor reduzido, pago mensalmente diretamente à administração Estamos ansiosos para ter você conosco! ☺
