It is a hands on engineering role for someone who gets satisfaction from solving complex data problems properly. About us Fullinfo is a self funded software company building a B2B company intelligence platform. We continuously crawl the open web and turn unstructured company websites, directories, registries and industry sources into clean, searchable company profiles. The result is a global database where users can search for specific company data and actually get the right answer. The product helps sales and marketing teams search across company data in a way that feels simple on the surface, but is technically complex underneath. Think natural language search, structured filters, company enrichment, relationship detection and reliable classification across many countries, industries and languages. Fullinfo currently works with a compact team of around 11 people, including backend engineers, frontend engineers, UX UI designers, DevOps and machine learning specialists. The team is small, international and focused on people who actually build, improve and ship the product. The culture is calm, direct and quality driven. People say what they do and do what they say. There is little room for ego, politics or vague ambition talk. The best fit is someone who is quietly driven, technically strong and genuinely interested in building something that works well. This is not the environment for people who constantly reinvent their profile, chase the next title or need a lot of structure around them. It is a strong fit for stable engineers who know their craft and like working with other people who take quality seriously. Role description As Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will work on the intelligence layer at the heart of Fullinfo’s product. Your work turns raw, noisy and unstructured web content into trustworthy data points. This includes things like industry classification, company maturity stage, tech stack, geography served, corporate hierarchy, entity matching and relationship detection. You will write Python, build and improve ML pipelines, integrate LLMs, evaluate model quality and make sure the system keeps producing accurate results at scale. The stack includes Python, Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers, boto3, AWS Lambda, SageMaker, S3, ECS, Terraform, Go and TypeScript. You will work closely with a small engineering team, but this is not a role where someone tells you every step to take. The direction is clear, the expectations are high, and the work needs to be done properly. You need to be comfortable figuring things out, validating assumptions and improving quality without needing constant confirmation. Your work includes: - Designing and improving models for classification, entity resolution and relationship detection - Working with noisy web scraped data across many languages and formats - Building ML pipelines that run reliably in production - Using LLMs for extraction, enrichment, validation and search related use cases - Working with embeddings, RAG, fine tuning and prompt engineering where it actually adds value - Defining evaluation metrics so model quality is measurable instead of based on gut feeling - Monitoring deployed models and improving them over time - Working with AWS services such as Lambda, SageMaker, S3 and ECS - Collaborating with backend engineers on production systems and data flows This role is a strong fit for someone who enjoys deep technical problems more than status. Someone who would rather fix a broken classification result than talk about building a team under them. Requirements You bring: - At least 5 years of hands on ML engineering experience - Strong Python skills - Experience with libraries such as Pandas, scikit learn, Transformers and boto3 - Real production experience with ML on AWS - Experience with LLMs, embeddings, RAG, prompt engineering or fine tuning - Comfort working with large scale, messy and semi structured data - Experience with JSON, NoSQL data and scraped web content - A strong eye for correctness and data quality - Business level English - The ability to work independently in a small remote team - A stable track record that shows depth, consistency and ownership Conditions - 12 month B2B contract - Fully remote work (GMT -3), you are allowed to have a 3 hour overlap - Flat structure with direct communication - Production product with real users and real data problems - Strong technical challenge around ML, LLMs, search and company intelligence - Compensation based on senior contractor level The hiring process includes an intro call, a technical assignment and a final conversation with the engineering team. Interested? Apply trough the link and get in touch with our consultant Lars Fullinfo is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match Fullinfo’s needs.

Confira a oportunidade para Cloud Engineer em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

My client, a US Software Company, with offices in Brazil, is seeking seeks a motivated individual to join their Cloud Services team as a Cloud Engineer. This role supports and maintains their cloud environments and DevOps processes in a mixed cloud environment while collaborating with senior engineers on infrastructure improvements and architecture decisions. The position involves implementing and maintaining cloud-based solutions using Terraform Infrastructure as Code (IaC). Primary Job Duties: Work in an issue and project tracking system to document task details and track time. Support and maintain the current cloud environment, infrastructure resources, applications, and project work. Monitor cloud environment health and performance, troubleshoot and resolve issues. Troubleshoot complex cloud infrastructure issues with minimal supervision. Design and maintain scalable Terraform infrastructure, including reusable modules and structured patterns for multi-environment or multi-account deployments, with strong practices for state management and version-controlled workflows Collaborate with senior engineers on cloud architecture and design. Maintain environment security using industry best practices and established policies and procedures. Support DevOps practices by working with development teams and stakeholders to maintain cloud resources and troubleshoot deployment issues. Create and maintain technical documentation, knowledge base articles, and operational runbooks. Contribute to the continuous improvement of our products, technology, and practices. Identify opportunities to improve infrastructure automation, monitoring, deployment workflows, and cost savings. Participate in incident reviews and root cause analysis. Improve system reliability through automation and observability. Qualifications Required Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are required for the Cloud Engineer II role. Minimum 2 years of experience with systems, infrastructure, or network administration. Minimum 2 years of experience operating infrastructure in AWS. Experience with infrastructure fundamentals including backup and recovery, disaster recovery, networking, and DNS. Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines and automated deployment workflows. Proficiency with monitoring, logging, and event analysis tools. Proficiency with Terraform and infrastructure-as-code practices in a version-controlled environment (e.G., Git). Proficiency in a common scripting language such as Python, bash, Perl, Ruby, or similar. Self-motivated with the ability to self-prioritize multiple tasks and execute accordingly. Able to work flexible hours outside normal business hours as required. Strong written communication skills for email, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Desired Qualifications: The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities that are highly desirable for the Cloud Engineer II role. Associate degree (AA/AS) in a technical field or equivalent professional experience. Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools (e.G., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar) for improving engineering productivity. AWS certification(s) such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, SysOps Administrator, or Developer. Experience administering Linux and/or Windows operating systems. Experience managing Active Directory or similar identity and directory services. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills. Ability to learn and implement new technologies quickly. Desire to gain knowledge and grow in the position. This is a CLT role and not open to PJ. Compensation is R$9000-R$12000/month plus bonus

description:

In addition to resolving advanced incidents, this role contributes to technical leadership, root cause analysis, documentation, and the planning and implementation of network solutions delivered through Professional Services engagements. Senior Network Engineers are expected to have deep expertise in enterprise networking and advanced firewall management across multiple platforms, with a strong focus on security, stability, and scalability of client environments. Key Responsibilities: Own the full lifecycle of complex network and firewall incidents, from detection through resolution and post-incident review, ensuring accountability for technical outcomes, stability, and documentation. Lead investigation and resolution of critical network incidents, driving coordination across internal teams, vendors, and customer stakeholders. Make technical decisions and take end-to-end ownership of network issues, driving resolution without reliance on further escalation. Lead technical delivery of network projects, including scoping, estimation, design, and implementation. Perform root cause analysis and develop long-term remediation strategies to prevent recurrence. Validate and approve network changes, designs, and remediation strategies. Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot Cisco, Palo Alto, and Fortinet networking and firewall equipment. Conduct targeted cleanup and improvements of existing network environments to ensure stability and scalability, minimizing customer downtime. Collaborate with the security team to ensure proper network hardening is in place and that all risks are properly mitigated or remediated. Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers. Contribute to architecture documentation, diagrams, and operational runbooks. Maintain awareness of developments within the networking and security technology landscape, recommending new solutions when necessary. Accurately track time and project activities within the company's time tracking system. Requirements 10+ years of experience within an MSP, VAR, ISP, NOC, or enterprise IT environment, with a focus on troubleshooting and maintaining existing network infrastructure. MUST BE fluent in English. Advanced, hands-on experience managing enterprise firewalls across multiple platforms — including Cisco (ASA/FTD/FMC), Palo Alto Networks (PAN-OS, Panorama), and Fortinet (FortiGate, FortiManager) — including policy design, rule optimization, VPN configuration, and threat prevention. Strong knowledge of networking protocols and technologies including TCP/IP, OSPF, BGP, EIGRP, IPSec, SNMP, STP, VTP, and VLANs. Strong knowledge of network infrastructure within virtualized environments using VMware or similar platforms, including virtual networking, VLAN configurations, virtual switches, and network segmentation. Experience troubleshooting performance and connectivity issues across different OSI layers. Experience with application-level network troubleshooting, including packet inspection and analysis. Proven experience optimizing, securing, and consolidating complex legacy network environments to meet current and future business needs. Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a customer-first approach to resolving network issues. Preferred Active CCNP certification or equivalent (Palo Alto PCNSE or Fortinet NSE 4/7 also valued). Experience with Cisco Unified Communications Manager (CUCM) and enterprise voice/unified communications infrastructure. Experience with cloud networking across AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including networking configurations, security settings, and integration with on-premises environments. Experience with network security practices including network hardening, monitoring, and threat assessment. Experience working in a Managed Service Provider (MSP) environment with exposure to ITIL-based service delivery models. Experience delivering customer-facing IT network projects. A degree or equivalent experience in computer science or a related field.

title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Ai Development Orchestrator em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Location: Remote Type: Full-Time Reports to: CEO Stack: TypeScript, Python, React (Next.Js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start: Immediate The Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale. The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems;  the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem;  the strongest output isselected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable. What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not\ "does it run\" - \"what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants.\ " Architect featuresas single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites. Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer;  the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.Js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role. Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.Md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy. Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications. Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. description:

ABOUT US Syniti, part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data. Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy. Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data. Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful SaaS solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively. THE ROLE We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance. What You’ll Do Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions. Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios. UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP. Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value. Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior. Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage. WHAT IT TAKES The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure). The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus. title: Assessor Pedagógico Pnld

Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil? Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. Necessário: Maior de 18 anos, fluente em Português e outro idioma. Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar. Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde. Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade. O diferencial? Aqui você é mais que um professor. Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas, onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos. Esta não é uma vaga CLT, mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora. Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas. Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar. Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos! O que eu faço? Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio. QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO? Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês. Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano. Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos. Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores. Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Arquiteto De Soluções Sênior
description:

Descrição da vaga A FCamara está em busca de identificar um(a) profissional capaz de compreender a fundo as necessidades do negócio e traduzi-las em soluções de arquitetura robustas, escaláveis e seguras, que agreguem valor à organização. Compreensão e Análise de Negócio: ➢ Mapear os domínios funcionais relevantes para o negócio. ➢ Definir as capacidades de negócio que cada domínio habilita e como elas contribuem para a geração de valor. ➢ Identificar e detalhar os requisitos (funcionais, negócio, dados, conformidade, leis e regulatórios, etc.). ➢ Detalhamento dos requisitos não funcionais (desempenho, segurança, escalabilidade, etc.) e definição de métricas claras para cada um. ➢ Priorizar os requisitos com base no valor para o negócio e nas restrições técnicas. Arquitetura e Design da Solução: ➢ Escolher padrões e estilos arquiteturais adequados (micros serviços, filas de mensagens, etc.). ➢ Explicar o motivo da escolha dos estilos e padrões arquiteturais, considerando os requisitos de negócio, as restrições técnicas e os trade-offs envolvidos. ➢ Considerar os trade-offs entre simplicidade e flexibilidade. ➢ Definir estratégias claras para lidar com o aumento da carga (escalabilidade). ➢ Implementar mecanismos de recuperação de falhas (resiliência). ➢ Atender aos requisitos de alta disponibilidade. ➢ Definir como os componentes se comunicam (protocolos, formatos de mensagem, etc). ➢ Escolher ferramentas e padrões de integração adequados e suas responsabilidades. ➢ Implementar autenticação, autorização e criptografia (segurança). ➢ Implementar mecanismos de proteção contra ataques (WAF, etc). ➢ Selecionar ferramentas e tecnologias adequadas para implementar a arquitetura, considerando aspectos como desempenho, custo, facilidade de uso e integração com outros sistemas. ➢ Justificar a escolha de cada ferramenta/tecnologia, demonstrando um entendimento de seus prós e contras. ➢ Demonstrar análise de impacto da solução proposta e em diferentes domínios (Dados, Segurança, Infraestrutura, Soluções e Software, etc.). ➢ Demonstrar a estimativa de custo da solução proposta. Documentação e Apresentação: ➢ Documentar a arquitetura da solução de forma clara e concisa. ➢ Criar diagramas que representam a arquitetura da solução, incluindo os componentes, suas interações e os fluxos de dados. ➢ Centralizar documentações (Readme). ➢ Descrever possíveis melhorias ou expansões da solução. ➢ Demonstrar capacidade de visão e planejamento a longo prazo. ➢ Discutir trade-offs e desafios enfrentados durante o desenvolvimento. Implementação e Operação: ➢ Definir métricas de monitoramento para acompanhar o desempenho, a disponibilidade e a segurança da solução. ➢ Implementar alertas para detectar problemas e responder rapidamente. ➢ Descrever ferramentas e técnicas para coletar, analisar e visualizar as métricas. Resolução de Problemas: Foco na causa raiz, trazendo soluções criativas tanto em código quanto em arquitetura. Gestão de tempo e Autonomia: Organizar suas entregas com qualidade, cumprindo prazos e destravando impedimentos de forma proativa. Quais são os requisitos? Será um diferencial: Experiência em migração de sistemas monolíticos/legados para microsserviços;  Experiência nasustentação de aplicações escaláveis utilizando Kubernetes e Terraform;  Familiaridade com pipelines de CI/CD (Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.);  Conhecimentos em Segurança da Informação (OWASP, OAuth2);  Conhecimento prático na integração de LLMs (OpenAI, Gemini, etc.) e no desenvolvimento de fluxos utilizando AI Agents. Em um contexto de mineração, ele atua como o elo de eficiência entre as equipes de desenvolvimento e os desafios operacionais de campo, garantindo que o time supere impedimentos técnicos e culturais na integração de sistemas industriais.Responsabilidades Principais Facilitação e Coach Ágil:Conduzir ritos (Daily, Planning, Review e Retrospective) garantindo o foco em resultados e a melhoria contínua do Time de Desenvolvimento. Apoio ao Product Owner:Auxiliar o PO na organização do backlog e na compreensão da agilidade técnica necessária para produtos voltados à operação mineira. Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de ciclo de vida de aplicação (Azure DevOps ou Jira). title: Lead Product Designer
description:
Empresa está contratando Lead Product Designer em campinas. Veja detalhes e envie seu currículo.

Who are we? Transcenda, headquartered in the US, was founded in July 2019 and is a full-lifecycle product development company. With locations throughout Romania, Poland, Ukraine, and Brazil, Transcenda works with Fortune 500 companies and well-funded startups to help bring new products to life. Transcenda helps companies ideate new product concepts, build prototypes, design world-class solutions then engineer new commercial products. Transcenda puts people first and strives to be a changemaker by building a better world through technology. Transcenda has grown from a 5-person team to over 250 people over the past four years and plans to continue growing. About the role This is a senior, consultancy-style design role. You'll move between leading projects end-to-end — driving discovery, aligning stakeholders, shaping direction — and rolling up your sleeves as a senior-level individual contributor when that's what the work needs. You'll be working on mature, live products where the bar is improving what exists: smoothing workflows, sharpening hierarchy, lifting conversion, and removing friction. This is not a greenfield, portfolio-piece role. If you get satisfaction from making a working product noticeably better for the people who use it every day, you'll like it here. Key responsibilities Take ownership of design problems on assigned projects — frame the problem, drive it through discovery, design, and delivery, and bring stakeholders along the whole way. Lead or contribute on a project depending on what's needed — sometimes you're directing the design effort, sometimes you're the one in Figma producing the work. Both modes should feel comfortable. Partner closely with product managers and engineers, translating ambiguous requirements into concrete, testable design solutions and iterating against live implementations. Run the iterative cycle from low-fidelity exploration through high-fidelity delivery, with usability validation at the points where it actually changes the outcome. Facilitate workshops, design reviews, and working sessions with cross-functional and executive stakeholders. Make decisions visible and trade-offs explicit. Mentor and raise the bar for designers around you. Build durable relationships with stakeholders. Understand what they're actually trying to achieve and push back constructively when the brief is wrong. Must haves 6–10+ years of UX/Product Design experience, ideally including time in a consultancy, agency, or embedded-team setting where you've owned client or stakeholder relationships directly. Demonstrated ability to flex between leading a project (or a small team) and contributing as a senior IC, depending on what the engagement needs. Track record of improving existing products rather than designing greenfield experiences — measurable wins on usability, conversion, or workflow efficiency. Strong visual and UI judgment for forms, workflows, CTAs, hierarchy, and layout. You can defend a layout decision on the merits. Comfort working closely with engineering against live implementations — you can read a real interface and tell us what's wrong with it before opening Figma. Ability to articulate why a design decision was made and what problem it solves, to audiences ranging from engineers to executives. Experience facilitating cross-functional workshops and leading business reviews or strategic planning sessions with senior stakeholders. Nice to have Background designing for regulated or enterprise domains (finance, compliance, GRC, banking, or similar). Experience designing software embedded inside third-party platforms. Familiarity with mature component libraries and design systems (MUI or similar). Experience mentoring or leveling up other designers through example and critique. Working knowledge of HTML/CSS;  JavaScript a plus. Degree in Design, HCI, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field — or equivalent experience.

title: Liquidity Partnership Manager
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Liquidity Partnership Manager em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

Role Overview We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across key regions. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution. The ideal candidate is highly connected within the local market, with a strong network of liquidity providers and a deep understanding of regional payment and banking landscapes. Key Responsibilities Business Development & Partnerships Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers Evaluate LP quality (pricing, depth, reliability, regions covered) Negotiate trading terms (spreads, fees, credit lines, margin terms) Market & Network Development Leverage existing network to expand LP coverage in key regions (APAC, LATAM, Africa) Maintain strong relationships with banks, payment providers, and liquidity partners Stay up to date with local market dynamics, pricing trends, and competitive landscape Execution & Collaboration Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, and execution quality Coordinate with internal teams to onboard LPs and ensure smooth operational setup Support ongoing performance monitoring and optimization of LP relationships Banking & Infrastructure Setup Facilitate opening of bank accounts and payment rails required for LP operations Identify suitable partners to support local currency flows and settlement Requirements 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, or liquidity management Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, or related financial services Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, and payment partners Proven ability to source and onboard LPs in local markets Strong understanding of regional market structures and liquidity dynamics Must have strong, deep LP network in at least one of the following regions: LATAM Vision & Mission OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors. OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Campaign Director
description:
Confira a oportunidade para Campaign Director em campinas. Veja requisitos e como se candidatar.

Duration: 1 year Employment type: Independent contractor agreement Location: Anywhere. Working hours must overlap at least 4 hours with GMT timezone Reporting to: Senior Director Salary: Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location Application closing date: June 1st 9am BST How to apply Do not apply through LinkedIn. Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here ( About the Secure Energy Project The Secure Energy Project (SEP) is a communications initiative that exists to build unstoppable support for a global shift to clean energy. We identify the obstacles slowing progress, then work with partners to design and run collaborative campaigns that remove them. We bring together allies across civil society, policy and industry to influence the narrative and politics of energy. The transition to clean energy can improve everything: lower bills, better jobs, cleaner air and more connected communities. Yet progress is still too slow and increasingly vulnerable to misinformation and political backlash. Now entering our third year, SEP is leading global communications efforts, coordinating campaign coalitions, and launching audience-led interventions in key countries. We're helping the climate movement fight smarter, faster, and together. Who we’re looking for We’re looking for a Campaign Director to help tell a bigger, bolder story about the energy transition - inspiring people to see clean energy as the foundation for healthier lives, stronger communities and greater security. You’ll help shift how people think and talk about energy by building communications that reach beyond the usual audiences. You’ll work with influencers, community voices, experts and unexpected allies to make clean energy feel practical, popular and urgent. To change everything, it takes everyone. That’s why you’ll help SEP play a leading role in networks that bring together hundreds of organisations working towards the same goal. You’ll spot opportunities for collaboration, support the leadership of others and help turn shared ambition into joint projects that are more than the sum of their parts. Working closely with the Senior Director, you’ll deliver news-driven, cutting-edge communications, support rapid-response work and coordinate with partners across our global network to share intelligence, test ideas and collaborate on high-impact interventions in public and political debates. This role is ideal for a strong communicator or campaigner who is both strategic and hands-on. You can translate big-picture strategy into compelling content, build trusted relationships with collaborators and move quickly when opportunities arise. We’re looking for someone who is ahead of the curve on communications and campaigns. You understand that speeding up the shift to clean energy means breaking out of echo chambers, building alliances with new audiences and unlikely partners, and shaping news agendas in real time with digital-first, innovative tactics. You’ll bring both the patience to take people with you and the punchiness to help shift the movement into a different gear. What you’ll do Drive narrative change on energy transition Work closely with the Senior Director to deliver SEP’s communications campaigns. Design innovative strategies, materials and interventions for major moments in the clean energy calendar, including summits, geopolitical events, campaign launches and report releases. Translate audience insights, polling and political analysis into strategic communications outputs tailored to specific audiences. Turn campaign strategy into creative ideas and interventions that can shift how people think and talk about energy. Help strengthen the wider clean energy movement by supporting the day-to-day coordination of SEP’s global networks and coalitions. Plan and run meetings, workshops and follow-up processes that encourage lively communication, practical collaboration and shared delivery. Build clear workplans, outputs and timelines to support delivery across multiple fast-moving projects. Track progress and keep partners and donors up to speed on what’s working, what’s not, and what that means for our collective impact. Narrative monitoring and rapid response coordination Spot the moments that matter - tracking media, politics and digital conversations to identify where clean energy narratives can be advanced, defended or reframed. Coordinate partners across SEP’s coalitions so the right voices are ready to speak out quickly, confidently and effectively. Produce rapid-response materials, including key messages, talking points, media pitches, briefing notes and digital content. Help SEP and its partners prepare for major events, risks and opportunities with clear plans, strong narratives and timely interventions. Media pitching and spokesperson training Support media outreach by drafting pitches, building targeted media lists, maintaining journalist relationships and proactively spotting opportunities to place clean energy stories and spokespeople. Identify strong spokespeople from across the clean energy NGO community and help prepare them for media interviews through messaging guidance, briefing materials and training opportunities. Build a broader, more diverse network of trusted voices for clean energy - including farmers, workers, community organisers, clean tech entrepreneurs, local leaders and others who can speak credibly to their own communities. Work with the Senior Director and other Communications Directors to activate spokespeople across traditional media and strategic online spaces. Strategic support and special projects Support the Senior Director with the design and delivery of new or evolving priority projects, ie. with our existing campaign to promote the benefits of solar power in Nigeria, or a cross-country campaign we’re developing to turbocharge electrification in the lead-up to COP31. Assist in drafting materials for fundraising proposals and donor communications. About you: You have a hunger to change the world, and are willing to take risks to change it. You think innovatively about communications and campaigns - you enjoy experimenting with new and outside-the-box approaches. You can influence people - you understand what makes people tick and how to get them on-side. You think strategically and you can also get things done. You’re extremely organised and you like keeping other people organised too. You're proactive - you don’t wait around to be asked to do something, you take the initiative and crack on. You don’t shy away from picking up the phone to strangers or chasing people who are ignoring your emails. You are confident enough to ask 'why?', to question the judgement of those more senior than you, and to admit when you’ve made mistakes. You have a good sense of humour, you don’t take yourself too seriously and you have excellent people management skills. You are comfortable working in an organisation guided by feminist values and have zero tolerance for misogyny, racism and bullying. Essential skills and experience 5+ years of experience in a communications, campaigns or media role. Does not have to be within the NGO sector. A creative mindset and strong interest in using storytelling and digital campaigning to drive change. Experience supporting or delivering communications campaigns. Strong writing and editing skills, with a track record for producing impactful media and digital content. Experience pitching to the media, drafting press releases and media briefings, and identifying and supporting spokespeople to deliver messages effectively. Good understanding of energy and climate issues, or proven ability to quickly build subject knowledge. Experience working across teams, organisations, and geographies. Highly organised, proactive, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, remote environment. Excellent English. Fluent Spanish would be a bonus, but it’s not essential. What we offer A chance to produce communications work that accelerates the transition to clean and affordable energy and changes the world in the process. The opportunity to get in on the ground floor of a small, high-ambition feminist start-up with a growing reputation. A collaborative, flexible, values-driven team with space to test and learn. Flexible working conditions, because childcare or other caring responsibilities are not hobbies. Opportunities to work across borders with partners and change-makers in climate and energy. Competitive compensation. Approx. USD $50,000 depending on location and experience. How to apply Do not apply through LinkedIn. Please apply by answering the role-specific questions which can be found here ( Deadline June 1st 9am BST

description:

JOB MISSION   The Product Engineer (Level II) at HwIT is a key technical contributor bridging RD innovation and global manufacturing. This professional actively supports the industrialization cycle  from first RD prototypes through NPI delivery to mass production  executing BOM control, product cost modeling, and equipment management for NPI, helping our customers  products achieve world-class manufacturing quality, competitive costs, and scalable production.   SCOPE  RESPONSIBILITIES   1.  Product Lifecycle  Financial Control  ·       BOM Management for Complex Products: Execute technical ownership of Bills of Materials, ensuring structural integrity, component traceability, and alignment with engineering changes.  ·       Product Cost Control: Assist in developing and maintaining detailed product cost models, tracking cost drivers around materials and processes, and supporting cost reduction initiatives.  ·       Engineering Change Control (ECR/ECN): Support the Engineering Change Request and Engineering Change Notice cycle, documenting modifications, capturing lessons learned, and evaluating industrial feasibility and cost impacts.  2.  Process Design, NPI, and Global Transference  ·       Process Flow, Requirements  Documentation: Assist in defining assembly process flows, line requirements, and maintaining comprehensive manufacturing documentation. Support process validations and failure analysis arising from process deviations.  ·       NPI Equipment Management: Help define technical specifications for production equipment and materials, tracking procurement activities in collaboration with RD and Manufacturing teams.  ·       Manufacturing Capacity Model: Develop and update assembly line capacity models, collecting yields and process times to assist in ensuring production scalability and feeding capacity utilization data into cost models.  ·       RD to Manufacturing Bridge: Execute the technical transference of validated processes from RD labs to high-volume manufacturing sites under senior technical guidance.  ·       Global Product  Process Support: Travel to Asia, Europe, and the Americas to provide on-site support for manufacturing technology learning, process debugging, yield improvement, and failure analysis.  ·       Equipment Transference Logistics: Assist in the logistics of equipment transfers between sites, tracking shipping, installation, and qualification.  ·       RD and Manufacturing Integration: Promote effective integration between RD and Manufacturing teams, bridging technical language and ensuring engineering decisions are applied in production.   3. CANDIDATE PROFILE   Technical Requirements  ·       Education: Bachelor s Degree in Production, Telecommunications, Electric, or Mechatronic Engineering.  ·       Experience: Minimum of 35 years in Product/Process Engineering in high-complexity industries.  ·       Professional Certification: Knowledge of PMI or ASQ frameworks (e.g., CAPM, Green Belt) is a plus.  ·       Global Mobility: Part of work time involves on-site visits to manufacturing and partner locations; remainder is local or remote.  ·       Expertise: Solid knowledge in NPI, equipment/materials management, capacity planning, and production failure analysis.  ·       Toolbox: Experience with PLM systems and JMP/Minitab. Technical knowledge in Python, C#, and/or LabVIEW is desirable.  Languages  ·       Portuguese: Native.  ·       English: Mandatory  Advanced/Fluent (B2/C1 level).  ·       Spanish: Bilingual  Desirable.  Soft Skills  (Aligned with HwIT Values)  ·       Superar (Overcome): Resilience to resolve technical issues under pressure in remote factory environments.  ·       Inovar (Innovate): Drive to find creative solutions to optimize assembly lines and identify root causes with the engineering team.  ·       Desenvolver (Develop): Active participation in team knowledge sharing and continuous personal development in complex NPI environments.

title: Desenvolvedor packaging fotonico pl
description:
Nova vaga disponível para Desenvolvedor packaging fotonico pl em campinas. Saiba mais sobre essa oportunidade.

JOB MISSION   HwIT is seeking a Packaging  Product Development Engineer focused on optical commutations products. You will be a key technical contributor supporting the hardware lifecycle of our photonic modules  from assisting in mechanical/thermal simulations and 3D CAD design to the execution, validation, and optimization of cleanroom packaging processes.  Your main focus will be a hands-on environment bridging RD design with manufacturing reality: supporting multiphysics simulations, detailing micro-assemblies, executing DOEs (Design of Experiments) for method validation, and technically investigating root causes to ensure structural integrity and maximize yield in global scale production.   SCOPE  RESPONSIBILITIES   1. Product Development and Validation  ·       Mechanical  Optomechanical Design for Packaging: Develop 3D CAD models and detailed 2D manufacturing drawings for high-precision optoelectronic packages, test fixtures, and structural assemblies, applying GDT standards.  ·       Multiphysics  Thermal Simulation: Conduct Finite Element Analysis (FEA) and Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) to simulate thermal dissipation, mechanical stress, and structural integrity of photonic modules.  ·       Prototyping  Design Validation: Support the rapid prototyping phase and work closely with the Reliability testing team to validate simulation models against empirical data from testing (e.g., Telcordia GR-468, MIL-STD).  2. Process Development and Validation  ·       Critical Parameter Optimization: Assist in defining and optimizing critical process parameters such as die attach (e.g., conductive epoxies, eutectic soldering), wire bonding, and optical alignment.  ·       Encapsulation Techniques: Develop hermetic and semi-hermetic encapsulation techniques for photonic modules.  ·       Material Qualification: Validate new materials, adhesives, and sealing processes according to high-reliability standards.  3. Yield Optimization and Troubleshooting  ·       Root Cause Investigation: Run investigative activities in cleanroom processes to detect the root cause of issues affecting the yield and assembly times of photonic components.  ·       Design of Experiments (DOE): Run DOEs to characterize processes, define critical variables, and find the best assembly recipes.  ·       SPC Alignment: Validate and approve operational methods and process parameters consistent with the Statistical Process Control (SPC) required by Product Engineering.            4. NPI Integration and Manufacturability  ·       Design for Manufacturing (DFM): Execute DFM and development activities in packaging components under senior guidance, promoting technical alignment between suppliers and developers, and evaluating the technical feasibility of new components.  ·       Team Training: Documentation and training the operational team in the meticulous execution of complex encapsulation recipes and methodologies;  ·       Process Transference: Collaborate side-by-side with Product Engineers and Senior Packaging Engineers to validate assemblies and transfer packaging assembly processes to high-volume manufacturing sites.   CANDIDATE PROFILE   Education  Background  Essential:  ·       Bachelor s Degree in Materials Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Electronics, Physics, or related fields.  ·       Minimum of 25 years of solid experience in microelectronic or optoelectronic packaging processes.  ·       Knowledge of structural adhesives, precision soldering, and interconnect metallurgy.  ·       Familiarity with failure analysis methodologies (SEM, EDS, X-Ray, Cross-section).  ·       Experience in optomechanical design, precision mechanics, or electronic hardware packaging.  ·       Proficiency in 3D CAD software (e.g., SolidWorks, Creo, Inventor) and understanding of GDT.  ·       Track record participating in thermal and structural simulations using tools like ANSYS, COMSOL, or SolidWorks Simulation.  Desirable:  ·       Experience with PICs (Photonic Integrated Circuits) and fiber-to-chip interfaces.  ·       Knowledge of reliability standards (MIL-STD-883, Telcordia GR-468, or NASA EEE-INST-002).  ·       Experience with continuous improvement tools (Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing).  ·       Knowledge of automation programming in Python, C#, or LabVIEW.  ·       Experience designing complex hermetic packages (e.g., Butterfly, TO-can) and managing micro-assembly tolerances.  ·       Background in designing customized mechanical fixtures for High-Temperature Operating Life (HTOL) and environmental testing.  Languages  ·       Portuguese: Native;   ·       English: Mandatory  Advanced/Fluent (B2/C1 level) for day-to-day communication with international partners.  ·       Spanish: Desirable.
